stage: Source-only formal runner preparation; requires completed caller proof, actual ASM review, exact source/binary freeze and a separate performance lease
calibration_power: 26 exactly once per geometry, round1/batch4096;0 for all other rows
outer_order: Round1: n ascending, declared cap ascending, batches4096/1/31; round2 reverses the complete18-process round1 ledger
filter_order: Original source filtered registry followed by the original source shuffle; round2 reverses that resulting list without consuming RNG
round_scope: The rounds differ in calibration history as well as reversed schedules; not an isolated order-effect experiment
public_contract: Same compiled Rust caller for every family; common prehash is supplied as8 little-endian bytes to public Poppy insert_bytes/contains_bytes, charging required public byte/iterator/error/cache/secondary-hash work
build_trial_disclosure: The unchanged caller emits build medians only. Eight build repetitions are source-bound; no invented build vectors or confidence intervals
quality_reuse: After exact constructor/geometry/seed/source-input interval and emitted mixed-output counts/checksum match, link cal0 rows to their original cal26 observation; raw rows remain unchanged and denominator is not pooled
cross_process_scope: Constructor/seed/source-derived interval plus emitted output fingerprints, not full-array cross-process byte comparison or emitted raw-input digest
within_process: The actual caller validates every dense output element against its canonical reference outside timing
poppy_prior_reproduction: Require actual backing bytes, mixed false positives, result checksum and calibration false positives to equal the committed public accuracy observation. insertions_returned_new is not emitted by this speed caller and is not claimed as remeasured
memory_cap: Actual bucket plus cache backing bytes; logical bucket bytes alone are not the charged allocation
proposed_placement: CPU2/socket0 parent and child, explicit child NUMA0 memory binding, inherited exclusive whole-matrix flock; requires final parent lease
failure_policy: Stop and preserve every failed outcome; no silent retry, omission, geometry replacement, seed change or automatic continuation
partial_results: Progress/counts only until complete raw/source/order/quality checks pass and the raw archive is committed
